history.administration_response: In its most recent resolution on cross- cutting issues (70/286), the General Assembly requested the Secretary-General to ensure that efficiency efforts were properly implemented, overseen and assessed and that the results of such efforts were reported to the Assembly in a transparent, consistent manner. Consequently, the resource efficiency group is expected to initiate its regular meeting in support of the current budget proposals for 2017/18 in the fourth quarter of 2016. The group will be focused on 3 key components: oversight of major reviews to be carried out, including on a mission-by-mission basis; specific review; and reporting of efforts and capturing of benefits generated. The Field Budget and Finance Division will act as the secretariat of the group and support it in ensuring that work programmes and outcomes are adequately recorded and reported.
history.board_assessment: Reconstitution of the resource efficiency group is in progress. On the basis of the reply, the recommendation is considered to have been implemented.
